title: Antivirus and antimalware: signatures, heuristics and limits

videos.script: An antivirus does not recognise danger. It recognises resemblance to something already judged. {{empty}} Here is a scanner with no signatures at all. It refuses to scan, and that is the lesson in one line. {{eicar}} So you write the signatures yourself. First for the EICAR test file, made to be detected. {{hash}} Then a hash signature, exact to the byte, and the variant it misses. {{content}} Then a content rule and a YARA rule, which catch the variant, and an innocent file too. {{quarantine}} You quarantine what was found instead of deleting it. {{limits}} And you finish with what no scanner can see, which is where the next lesson begins.
